RT.Fields.@Core.Description: Terms of go-runtime for field labels, mandatory fields, value lists and data classes
RT.Fields.@Core.LongDescription: The kernel derives these annotations from data elements, business objects and foreign keys, so that generic user interfaces can show and check entities without code of their own.

ShortLabel.@Core.Description: Short label of the field, at most 10 characters

MediumLabel.@Core.Description: Medium label of the field, at most 20 characters

LongLabel.@Core.Description: Long label of the field, at most 40 characters

Heading.@Core.Description: Column heading of the field, at most 40 characters

Mandatory.@Core.Description: The field needs a value when the instance is saved: not null, and for text not the empty string

ValueList.@Core.Description: An entity set of the service whose entities give the values of the field, along a foreign key

EntitySet.@Core.Description: The entity set with the values

Parameters.@Core.Description: The properties of the annotated entity and of the entity set that correspond

DataClass.@Core.Description: The data class of the entity: application, configuration or runtimeConfiguration

Origin.@Core.Description: The package whose behavior or extension reported a message or added an annotation
